categories.main_business_segments: Suntar Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: membrane technology applications and water investment and operation. The membrane technology segment includes industrial liquid separation, membrane water treatment, environmental engineering, spare parts, and residential water purification devices. The water investment and operation segment focuses on municipal sewage treatment plant investment and operation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops advanced inorganic non-metallic membrane materials and high-performance composite membranes, including nanofiltration cores, ceramic membranes, hollow fiber membranes, MBR membranes, spiral membranes, and graphene membranes. It integrates membrane materials, components, equipment, software, and applications into a complete industrial chain. Production involves in-house manufacturing of membrane materials and assembly of membrane components and equipment, with some standardized parts outsourced. The company employs proprietary technologies such as nanofiltration, ceramic membrane fabrication, membrane bioreactors (MBR), and membrane software for process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Suntar serves industrial customers in pharmaceutical manufacturing, biochemistry, food and beverage, petrochemical, metallurgy, salt lake lithium extraction, and environmental protection sectors. It also serves municipal water management authorities and residential end-users for water purification. Key markets include industrial process liquid separation, wastewater treatment and reuse, municipal sewage treatment, and residential water purification.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with over 90% of revenue and assets located domestically. It has production and R&D facilities in Shaanxi (Yan'an), Fujian (Xiamen), and subsidiaries in multiple Chinese provinces. Internationally, it has subsidiaries and offices in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Indonesia, and Thailand, focusing on Southeast Asia and Middle East markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Suntar operates across the entire membrane industry supply chain, from upstream membrane material development and production, through midstream membrane component and equipment manufacturing, to downstream membrane system integration and application services. It also extends into water investment and operation, managing municipal sewage treatment facilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation with a strategic focus on developing new membrane materials, improving membrane performance, and expanding membrane applications. It invests in R&D centers, including a new Singapore facility, and collaborates with universities and research institutes. Key R&D areas include nanofiltration, ceramic membranes, graphene membranes, membrane bioreactors, and membrane software. The company aims to enhance import substitution, expand international markets, and integrate membrane technology with water treatment operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of membrane materials, membrane components, membrane equipment, and integrated membrane system solutions. The company also earns income from water investment and operation services, charging fees based on treated water volume and quality. Additional revenue streams include sales of spare parts, cleaning agents, and residential water purification devices. The company participates in EPC, BOT, BT, and TOT project models for water infrastructure projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Suntar is a leading domestic player in China's membrane technology and water treatment industry, recognized for its comprehensive membrane industry chain and advanced proprietary technologies. It is among the earliest and most authoritative membrane technology developers and application solution providers in China, with a strong market position in industrial liquid separation and municipal water treatment. The company faces competition from international membrane technology firms entering China but leverages local innovation and integrated service capabilities to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Suntar reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 1.39 billion, a slight decrease of 4.11% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 314.8 million, an increase of 23.97%. Total assets reached RMB 6.12 billion, up 10.53%, and net assets attributable to shareholders were RMB 4.05 billion, up 6.35%. The company maintains steady growth with increasing profitability and invests about 4.81% of revenue in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Suntar offers a full-spectrum membrane industry chain solution from materials to applications, emphasizing proprietary advanced membrane materials with superior performance such as high flux, anti-fouling, and durability. Its membrane solutions enable customers to improve product quality, increase yield, reduce resource consumption, and minimize environmental impact, aligning with green manufacturing and clean production goals. The company’s integrated membrane software and system integration capabilities provide customized, high-efficiency separation and water treatment solutions tailored to diverse industrial and municipal needs.
